classifications.rationale: The Administration states that it will continue negotiations with private insurers to reach a voluntary compromise; this is discretionary implementation activity and does not itself change legal rights or require a specified later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: we will continue to pursue an agreeable compromise with these companies

classifications.rationale: The President directs Secretary Mathews to seek manufacturers’ voluntary cooperation while negotiations continue; the action is executive coordination and advocacy, with no dictated or self-executing legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: I have directed Secretary Mathews to ask for the cooperation of the manufacturers again
